observations: Sodium Laureth Sulfate and Coco-Betaine form the main cleansing system.
Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride is a cationic deposition polymer.
Hydroxypropyltrimonium Lemon Protein is a cationic protein-derived film signal.
Salicylic Acid, Fumaric Acid and Citric Acid are present, but finished pH and contact-time intent are unknown.
Multiple fragrance allergens, citrus extracts and grapefruit peel oil are listed.

claims.textVerbatim: Vegane Formel mit Grapefruit-Extrakt, Vitamin B6 und Niacinamiden; stärkt die Haarfaser, revitalisiert und verleiht Glanz; für starkes Haar voller Volumen; ohne Silikone; dermatologisch getestet.

cleansingStrength.rationale: SLES is the lead surfactant and Coco-Betaine is the main moderator; this supports strong ordinary cleansing, not clarifying by itself.

supportingSignals.observation: SLES plus Coco-Betaine is a strong ordinary cleansing chassis.
supportingSignals.inference: SLES is the lead surfactant and Coco-Betaine is the main moderator; this supports strong ordinary cleansing, not clarifying by itself.

counterSignals.observation: Conditioning polymers and pearlizers may soften feel but do not lower the SLES-led cleansing band.
counterSignals.inference: Conditioning polymers and pearlizers may soften feel but do not lower the SLES-led cleansing band.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Cationic guar, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Lemon Protein, Glycol Distearate and Octyldodecanol support moderate non-silicone surface conditioning.

supportingSignals.observation: Cationic guar, cationic lemon protein and emollient/pearlizer signals support moderate conditioning.
supportingSignals.inference: Cationic guar, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Lemon Protein, Glycol Distearate and Octyldodecanol support moderate non-silicone surface conditioning.

counterSignals.observation: No silicone and no rich lipid system, so not high conditioning.
counterSignals.inference: No silicone and no rich lipid system, so not high conditioning.

weightPotential.rationale: The cationic polymer is one substantive route; protein-film and lipid/emollient cues are weak, so v1.4 supports moderate rather than high weight.

supportingSignals.observation: One substantive cationic polymer route plus weak protein/lipid support stays moderate.
supportingSignals.inference: The cationic polymer is one substantive route; protein-film and lipid/emollient cues are weak, so v1.4 supports moderate rather than high weight.

counterSignals.observation: Two weak support routes do not become high without a second distinct substantive route.
counterSignals.inference: Two weak support routes do not become high without a second distinct substantive route.

focusPrimary.rationale: The product name and manufacturer claims emphasize Kraft/strength; formula support is compatible only as temporary cosmetic repair/surface reinforcement.

supportingSignals.observation: Strengthening/Kraft claims map to conservative cosmetic repair over cationic polymer/protein surface care.
supportingSignals.inference: The product name and manufacturer claims emphasize Kraft/strength; formula support is compatible only as temporary cosmetic repair/surface reinforcement.

counterSignals.observation: Strengthening is not biological fiber repair; the claim is capped to cosmetic surface support.
counterSignals.inference: Strengthening is not biological fiber repair; the claim is capped to cosmetic surface support.

focusSecondary.rationale: Glanz is explicit in the name/claims and has an independent smoothing/film route, so one secondary `shine` is justified; volume is left out to respect ordinary max-one secondary.

supportingSignals.observation: Glanz is separately named and has an S1 smoothing/film route distinct enough to keep one secondary.
supportingSignals.inference: Glanz is explicit in the name/claims and has an independent smoothing/film route, so one secondary `shine` is justified; volume is left out to respect ordinary max-one secondary.

counterSignals.observation: Volume wording exists, but the most material distinct secondary in the name is shine.
counterSignals.inference: Volume wording exists, but the most material distinct secondary in the name is shine.

usageRole.rationale: Normal shampoo application and strong cleansing mean no frequent role; there is no reset/deep-cleansing or accepted active-treatment trigger.

supportingSignals.observation: Manufacturer use is normal shampoo; dm daily wording does not override strong-cleansing frequent trigger rules.
supportingSignals.inference: Normal shampoo application and strong cleansing mean no frequent role; there is no reset/deep-cleansing or accepted active-treatment trigger.

counterSignals.observation: Daily-use wording from dm would not qualify for frequent because cleansing is strong and manufacturer use is ordinary.
counterSignals.inference: Daily-use wording from dm would not qualify for frequent because cleansing is strong and manufacturer use is ordinary.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Dermatologisch getestet and salicylic acid exposure do not equal a cosmetic scalp-comfort target; no dry, itchy, flaky or sensitive-scalp positioning is revealed.

supportingSignals.observation: Dermatologisch getestet is not a dry/itchy/sensitive scalp comfort target.
supportingSignals.inference: Dermatologisch getestet and salicylic acid exposure do not equal a cosmetic scalp-comfort target; no dry, itchy, flaky or sensitive-scalp positioning is revealed.

counterSignals.observation: Fragrance allergens and citrus oils are exposure flags, not the basis for a negative comfort verdict.
counterSignals.inference: Fragrance allergens and citrus oils are exposure flags, not the basis for a negative comfort verdict.

dandruffSupport.rationale: The complete manufacturer formula contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; Salicylic Acid is not accepted for the locked dandruff rule.

supportingSignals.observation: Piroctone Olamine and Climbazole are absent.
supportingSignals.inference: The complete manufacturer formula contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; Salicylic Acid is not accepted for the locked dandruff rule.

counterSignals.observation: Salicylic Acid and normal cleansing can affect residue/skin feel but are not Piroctone Olamine or Climbazole.
counterSignals.inference: Salicylic Acid and normal cleansing can affect residue/skin feel but are not Piroctone Olamine or Climbazole.

gateDiagnostics.weightDepositionLoad: Die Beschwerung wird qualitativ aus v1.4-Route-Arten abgeleitet; INCI liefert keine exakten Einsatzmengen oder Wiederholungs-/Residue-Daten.
gateDiagnostics.weightPersistence: Persistenz bleibt mechanistisch begrenzt, weil keine wiederholten Shampoo-only Ablagerungsdaten im Quellenpaket vorliegen.
gateDiagnostics.weightResetCapacity: Reset-Kapazität wird nur aus Tensid-/Chelator-/Klärungsarchitektur abgeleitet; keine Fertigprodukt-Resetprüfung ist erfasst.
gateDiagnostics.r3FormulaSignalNote: Keine anerkannte echte Bond-Repair-Route wird aus INCI abgeleitet; Plex/Keratin/Protein-Sprache bleibt kosmetisch und temporär.

evidence.scopeNotes: Exact-market formula and unblinded product/source-packet claim audit only; no public shampoo-only finished-product performance endpoint is captured.

claimAudit.claim: Stärkt die Haarfaser, revitalisiert und verleiht Glanz
claimAudit.support: Cationic guar, cationic lemon protein derivative, Glycol Distearate/Octyldodecanol and acids support temporary surface care and smoothing/shine routes.
claimAudit.limitation: No shampoo-only strengthening endpoint is captured; manufacturer and dm show formula drift, and the manufacturer formula is canonical.

medicalBoundary.rationale: Dermatologisch getestet plus strengthening/shine language remains cosmetic product positioning and does not assert disease treatment.
